msg: There are 8 gnomes, each of varying colours. Anything of the red side of the spectrum, red pink, brown, purple will be assigned a red basket. Any gnome not of these colours is assigned a yellow basket. The gnomes will offer increasing amounts of mushrooms which will then decline again, try to stick with the decline until it hits around 5 to 7 mushrooms. After this, switch the colour you're on. Use your 1x multipliers to test the gnomes. If one has been consistent for a while, but middling in numbers, use a 1x to test the opposite colour and see if it is time to switch up. Play it safe with the 5x as these will get you the most points, if one gnome colour is doing well and you get a 5x, stick with it. The pattern is not perfect, sometimes they may seem nearly identical in mushroom results. In this instance, pick a colour gnome and stick with it for 2-3 rounds, you will see a decline or incline and know whether to stay or swap. Sacrifice x5 in this instance only, but try to use 1x as much as possible. Good luck gnome-ing!
